rich_text.text: Have your photo taken at the photo booth → take the barcode
Take a queue ticket (it shows your section and your number)
Go to your section → wait until your number is called to a desk → go to the officer
Submit the documents and pay the fee
If you don't have a completed form, ask the officer for one → they will print it for you → go to the shared desks and fill it in (any language is fine).
You may return to the same officer with the completed form, or you may need to take a new ticket and go to another officer.
My case (Dmitriy S.): I didn't meet a single officer I could talk to in Russian. Across all my visits to the Public Service Hall in Tbilisi, all communication with ~5 officers was in English only.

title: How to apply at the Public Service Hall (House of Justice)
